summary: First testing pass for myBazaarCart Expo+FastAPI grocery app. Backend: 14/14 functional API tests PASSED (health, banner with '1500 L' message, 19 categories with emojis/coming_soon flags, products list/filter/search, product 404, login success/wrong-creds, cart auth-required/CRUD with correct subtotal_lek, COD order with free-delivery when subtotal>=1500 LEK and cart cleared, /api/me PATCH for language/currency). OTP signup tests SKIPPED because the Twilio account configured in /app/backend/.env is real and rejects synthetic Albanian test numbers (HTTP 400 'not a valid phone number' -> backend correctly bubbles up as 502); debug_code fallback never fires while real Twilio creds are configured. Frontend smoke (mobile viewport 390x844): onboarding renders all 7 language chips + 2 currency chips + continue button, navigates to login, login with demo/demo1234 navigates into tabs, Home shows promo banner, 8 category tiles, best-seller grid (20 products), category tap opens Snacks list with 39 products, and tapping Add updates the bottom-tab Cart badge to '1'. No deprecated Expo packages or red-screen errors detected.

minor.issue: When Twilio returns 21211 (invalid 'To' number) backend raises 502, but does NOT expose debug_code for dev/test. With real Twilio creds it is impossible to QA the OTP signup flow end-to-end using mock numbers. Consider exposing debug_code when Twilio errors out (e.g. on TwilioRestException) so signup can be e2e tested without consuming SMS quota, OR document a Twilio-verified test number.

action_items: (Optional) Backend: in /app/backend/server.py _send_sms_otp, when TwilioRestException is caught, instead of (or in addition to) raising 502, optionally return {sent: false} so send_register_otp can still surface debug_code in dev. Otherwise, document that real Albanian numbers are required for OTP testing.
(Optional) Test credentials: add a Twilio-verified test phone in /app/memory/test_credentials.md so QA can run the full OTP flow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~620 lines; still readable but approaching the 700-line guideline — consider splitting routers (auth, cart, orders) into modules when adding more endpoints.
MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via {'_id': 0} projections — good.
All env vars (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) are read from .env without hardcoded defaults — good.
Frontend api.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with empty-string fallback — good (no hardcoded URL).
All interactive elements verified to expose testID (onboard-*, login-*, home-*, home-cat-*, add-to-cart-*) which made automation reliable.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 executed, 2 skipped due to real-Twilio constraint)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (onboarding -> login -> home -> category -> add-to-cart -> cart badge all verified)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. The backend startup hook seeds 19 categories, 174 products and the demo user (demo/demo1234) idempotently — verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: https://bharat-app-8.preview.emergentagent.com (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Demo user demo/demo1234 has pre-saved Tirana address; can place COD orders end-to-end. To exercise the OTP signup path, either (a) modify backend to surface debug_code on TwilioRestException, or (b) use a Twilio-verified Albanian (+355) phone number. Pytest suite: /app/backend/tests/test_mybazaarcart_api.py. Frontend mobile viewport 390x844; all testIDs work; cart badge is rendered in the bottom Cart tab label as a numeric suffix.
rca_of_issue: OTP signup tests cannot complete because real Twilio creds in /app/backend/.env reject all synthetic phone numbers with error 21211 ('not a valid phone number'). Backend correctly converts that into HTTP 502 and never reveals the OTP. This is not a bug in the OTP code path itself — the verify-otp logic, debug_code fallback (mock mode), and duplicate-username check are all correctly implemented; they're just unreachable from automated tests in the current Twilio configuration.
